name: hero-ai-value-proposition
blurb: Light-themed hero with scroll-triggered stagger and interactive app mockup.
description: Full-screen hero (light background) with headline, description, CTA, and embedded design-app mockup. Uses TimelineAnimation for scroll-based stagger of text, buttons, avatars, and card selections.
use_when: Designer-focused B2B product with emphasis on a visual preview or interactive demo.
avoid_when: Requires scroll handler and TimelineAnimation context. Heavy on layout-shift animations; can feel slow on low-end devices.
a11y: Navigation and CTA buttons are focusable. Stagger animations have no prefers-reduced-motion guard.
